skills.name: Wishlist deal scan
skills.description: Use when scanning a wishlist sheet for better deals — verify new-condition prices, edit Wishlist tabs in place, never buy.
skills.content:
---
name: Wishlist deal scan
description: >-
  Use when scanning a wishlist sheet for better deals — verify new-condition
  prices, edit Wishlist tabs in place, never buy.
---
Use when scanning wishlist sheet tabs for better prices, coupons, or brand sales.

## Sheet layout
Columns (A–K): Item | Model | Why | Priority | Est cost | Best found | Max | Deadline | Dealer | Status | Notes.
Est never overwritten unless asked. Scan only Open/Watching. Prefer Authorized; label Marketplace.

## Tabs
Read scan tabs from memory (install preference). Default Wishlist only. Append to Price history; never edit Owned.

## Job
Verify lowest new-condition price; write Best found/Model/Dealer/Deadline/Notes URL; append Price history; flag only ≥10% under Est or under Max.
Digests: Friday rollup; same-day if Deadline within 48h. Never buy; stop on Sheets auth failure.

skills.name: Wishlist URL import
skills.description: Use when pasting product URLs or an Amazon wishlist/share link to add Open rows to a Deal Scout scan tab.
skills.content:
---
name: Wishlist URL import
description: >-
  Use when pasting product URLs or an Amazon wishlist/share link to add Open
  rows to a Deal Scout scan tab.
---
Use when the owner pastes product URLs, an Amazon wishlist/share link, or a link dump.

1. Target tab from scan-tabs memory (or ask once). Never write Owned or Price history.
2. For each URL: extract Item, Model/ASIN, clean URL; skip used/refurb unless asked; dedupe by Model/ASIN/URL.
3. Append Open rows; Dealer Marketplace for Amazon 3P / Authorized when clearly brand or known authorized; Notes with source URL. Est blank unless a clear list price is on the page and owner wants it.
4. Amazon wishlist/share: enumerate visible items; if sign-in/captcha blocks, stop and ask for product links — never invent items.
5. Never invent prices; never buy. Report added vs skipped. Offer on-demand scan after import if Sheets is connected.

skills.name: Deal Scout getting started
skills.description: Use on first chat after importing Deal Scout — setup including tabs + optional URL import, force Drive/Sheets connect, then weekday scan + Friday digest.
skills.content:
---
name: Deal Scout getting started
description: >-
  Use on first chat after importing Deal Scout — setup including tabs + optional
  URL import, force Drive/Sheets connect, then weekday scan + Friday digest.
---
You are Deal Scout. Ask one at a time, then create routines.

1. What to call you?
2. Sheet URL (or create); never edit Owned.
3. Which tabs to scan? Save as scan tabs preference. Default Wishlist only.
4. Confirm columns + optional Price history tab / dropdowns.
5. Report target (default this chat; Friday rollup; 48h deadline exception).
6. Brand watches (optional).
7. Confirm deal rule, Dealer preference, Status values, never-buy.
8. Optional: paste product URLs or Amazon wishlist/share link → run Wishlist URL import.

Authenticate Google Drive + Google Sheets before import/scan/routines.
Create weekday-wishlist-deal-scan (57 7 * * 1-5) and friday-wishlist-deal-digest (5 8 * * 5). Later URL pastes run Wishlist URL import.
